stillCut.marks: The existing cut-relative annotations schema; no nativeCapture on this cut.

sourceImage.path: uncropped original extracted frame, at its decoded source dimensions

requirements: Receipt, movie, source image, original video and optional composed image hashes are checked against actual files.
Receipt frames and completed must equal the whole cut frame count; generated movie must be exactly 1920x1080, 60fps with that frame count and square pixels.

Original-video timestamp must be finite, nonnegative and before its duration. An actual decoded frame near that timestamp must have genuine FHD-or-higher dimensions, equal the receipt and uncropped source image dimensions.

The image hash and timestamp are extraction provenance bound by the receipt, not an independently verified pixel-to-video match. The helper must record the true extraction timestamp; no human viewing claim is inferred.

layout.crop, when used, is integer x,y,width,height within the original image. layout.viewport is positive in-frame evenpixel x,y,width,height. Optional imageOutput must be 1920x1080; omit the entire imageOutput field when absent.
Original gameplay rights and source selection remain separate required evidence. A complete technical receipt does not establish permission or human visual/listening approval.

Keep the existing nativeCapture schema unchanged for Unity. Missing, stale, incomplete or ambiguous dual receipts fail; the native source/request/success hashes and compiled fingerprints remain mandatory.
Stills and Unity demonstrations are explanation, never independent-gameplay. No gameplay FHD, source hash, speed, source-cut or native provenance check has been relaxed.

annotations.behavior: Both kinds use annotations(cut,plan). Marks must remain outside fixed captions, source-kind chip and cut.protectedRects, clear at each cut and represent editorial guidance.

ratioChoice.choiceRequired: Same episode/slug/revision, basis recommended-production-choice-v1, defaultContractAcknowledged actual60:explanation40, nonempty local scope/decision/reasons; choice JSON must be inside this revision.
ratioChoice.expectedGameplayShare: Required numeric exact gameplayFrames/bodyFrames, within floating point tolerance 1e-12; not a desired quota.
ratioChoice.withoutChoice: Default actual60:explanation40 enforced with ratioToleranceFrames at most1.
ratioChoice.withChoice: Report measured share and verified choice hash; no global bypass, other-episode permission or actual human approval is inferred.

coverage: default and local-choice ratio paths; wrong scope/basis/hash, invented share and tolerance bypass rejected
still and Unity chip plus annotations; chip/caption collisions rejected
native complete success path and incomplete/status/fingerprint/request/hash failures
still complete success path and incomplete/fps/scope/movie/source hash/timestamp/dimensions/layout/crop/dual-receipt/partial-cut failures
validation.limits: Inline CPU tests mocked audio_pipeline import and media/image/probe/receipt branches. The actual current choice file/hash and installed annotation font were used. No encoded media or human visual/audio quality pass is claimed.
